source: RC1 deep review, the coordinator's third batch and ruling of 2026-11-23 (design A), DR2-G-1 (handler mappings); RFC 0006 §7 (sentences proposed in the PR)
statement: On a Spring Cloud Gateway host in enforce mode, CoSec decides gateway routes only, and the application's own controllers, functional routes and handler mappings (a WebSocket endpoint's among them) are served outside any route: startup fails, naming each such handler, the property and the page, unless cosec.gateway.unprotected-handlers lists it by bean name. A listed name with * is refused (no handler is listed by a pattern), a listed name that matches no handler is ignored, as for cosec.gateway.unprotected-endpoints (STA-2), and the handlers listed are named in one INFO line at startup.
guards: spring-boot:GatewayOwnHandlersTest#a handler of the application that is not listed fails startup, naming it, the property and the page
spring-boot:GatewayOwnHandlersTest#every handler listed starts, and a name that matches no handler is ignored
spring-boot:GatewayOwnHandlersTest#a controller and a functional route are not seen by a gateway global filter, a route is
spring-boot:GatewayOwnHandlersTest#a handler mapping of the application that is not listed fails startup, naming it
